prompt:
IT MUST NOT LOOK AI-GENERATED: a real candid documentary photograph taken by a working photographer on a full-frame mirrorless camera with a real lens. Realism comes from PEOPLE, LIGHT AND MATERIALS, not from dirt: visible skin pores, fine wrinkles, uneven skin tone, stray hairs, natural fabric creases, real paper texture, soft dust visible only in a beam of light, slight motion blur on moving hands, subtle natural lens vignetting, a slightly imperfect un-staged composition. The SPACE is clean, cared-for and organized like a premium creative studio: only one or two lived-in details (a mug, a notebook); NO dirt, NO stains, NO coffee rings, NO loose tape scraps, NO tangled cables, NO mess. No plastic skin, no perfect symmetry, no glossy CGI surfaces, no over-sharpening, no HDR, no beauty retouching, no stock-photo smiles. Natural true-to-life color with no color grading; highlights keep detail, shadows open. Latin American people with real, characterful faces. PRINTED MATTER EXISTS but is never readable: book spines, labels, packaging, papers and screens are present exactly as they would be in any real working room, and they are kept ILLEGIBLE BY PHYSICAL MEANS ONLY — too small, out of focus, cut by the frame edge, at a steep angle, turned away or lost in shadow — NEVER by being blank. NO blank book spines, NO empty labels, NO unmarked packaging, NO featureless screens: a room where nothing at all carries writing reads as fabricated. No logos, no brand marks, no watermarks, and no text sharp enough to actually read.

VISUAL IMPACT (this is an award-level editorial photograph, the kind that stops the scroll): ONE bold visual idea per frame; LIGHT WITH CHARACTER — a hard, directional beam of real sunlight or a single strong source sculpting the subject, with crisp graphic shadows and rich but detailed darks (never flat, never evenly lit); a DECISIVE MOMENT at the peak of the action; a GRAPHIC COMPOSITION with strong geometry, clear figure-ground separation and generous calm negative space; THREE distinct depth planes (blurred foreground, sharp subject, soft background). COLOR: natural true-to-life color, no grading; a restrained palette where bright azure blue (#0375DB) emerges naturally in the spatial composition through scene light, reflections, real materials or the relationship between depth planes, creating graphic rhythm without requiring a separate blue prop; everything else calm and neutral-warm; highlights keep detail; white balance warm-neutral, shadows never blue.

MOTIVATED LIGHT — verify it by these landmarks: the light on the subject comes from a SOURCE THAT IS VISIBLE IN THE FRAME — a monitor, a screen, a practical lamp, a window — and that source is what lights them. The fall-off is visible: the side of the face nearest the source is lit and the far side drops into darkness, with the direction reading unmistakably from the source. Colour comes from the real source, never from a colour filter or a grade over the whole image.

VERTICAL 4:5 composition. All heads and hands stay BELOW 36% of the frame height. TEXT SPACE (planned, essential): the TOP 30% of the frame is genuine dark neutral matte mineral plaster in even shadow, fine grain, a DEEP, warm, evenly toned shadow, deep but ALWAYS keeping visible texture and detail of the material — never a flat pure-black panel, never an evenly filled shape — dark enough for white text, with no objects, windows, light beams or bright spots in it, reserved for a headline.

Register B deliberately staged editorial portrait. A fictional adult female strategy professional about 38, short dark hair, charcoal-gray tailored jacket over warm-white top, looks directly into the camera with composed confidence. THE MOMENT: she firmly presents ONE open thin silver iPad Pro as the chosen launch route. Its screen shows luminous azure original digital artwork of a silver sculptural wearable with one small orange diagonal accent. Two other silver iPads are closed and set aside on the left of the pale mineral desk: one route chosen, two deferred. Head fully below 43% frame height. A small real studio LED source is mounted low at lower right, visibly providing a hard neutral rim, the brightest neutral-white source; never an amber practical lamp. Real skin details, editorial tension, no stock smile, no floating graphics. Large azure screen and local reflections on aluminum. Photographic Efeonce direction: specific contemporary digital craft, honest physical materials, three optical planes, decisive moment. Neutral-warm 5200K daylight with hard directional sculpting and open neutral shadows, no sepia or blue shadow grade. Azure #0375DB is unmistakably present in the digital work itself and its honest local reflections, not a blue room or clothing. One restrained orange #F55D01 detail belongs to the work. No green props. White and silver stay neutral white and silver. Native vertical 4:5. Top 40 percent is genuinely empty dark neutral matte fine mineral plaster in even shadow for later copy, no objects, faces, beams, screens or bright patches. Active scene between 43 and 79 percent height; all of the head below 42 percent if a person is visible. Bottom 18 percent is the specifically named real dark foreground, completely optically out of focus, with soft natural transition. Never a black added band. No text, letters, numbers, headline, logotypes, logos, signature or watermark. Equipment if present: recent slim Apple Studio Display, silver MacBook Pro, iPad Pro with thin even bezels, white Apple Pencil Pro, white low-profile Magic Keyboard. No old monitors or old keyboards. Optical premium editorial photography, subtle realistic skin and material detail, no artificial smooth CG finish, no gratuitous dirt.

FOREGROUND (planned): the dark matte box of the actual camera rig close to the bottom of the lens, so close to the lens that it dissolves into a soft abstract blur with no visible edges or details, spanning the ENTIRE width of the bottom 18% of the frame (never a hard band), DARK neutral near-black charcoal; its center calm and even.
